notes: Statement parsing and category labeling now run through a private, self-hosted AI gateway instead of Gemini. The Gemini API key and model settings are replaced by a single access token, and any previously saved Gemini credentials are cleared on upgrade. The access token is now sent in an Authorization header rather than the URL. Local-rule fallback, mapping enforcement, and the code-owned amount sign are unchanged. Without an access token the app still imports using local rules.
